title: Billing renders Manage billing link using SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl

summary: Added SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl (https://homelab.local/billing/portal) in libs/shared-contracts; billing renders 'Manage billing' link from it. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts in the monorepo is the 'shared configuration' (inlined at build); added a new field rather than reusing billingUrl; link in same tab, no styling spec.
